import pandas as pd

df = read_df("/opt/abb-sdk-repo/examples/datasets/titanic.csv")

# Define binary churn target
# Positive label (1) = record did NOT survive (Survived == 0)
df["Churn"] = (df["Survived"] == 0).astype(int)

print("Class balance of 'Churn':")
print(df["Churn"].value_counts().sort_index())
print("\nCross-check against 'Survived':")
print(pd.crosstab(df["Survived"], df["Churn"], rownames=["Survived"], colnames=["Churn"]))
print("\nData with new target:")
print(df[["Survived", "Churn"]])
